answer: An identity that attests to another stakes 14% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. The comet escrow holds each stake, the wharf settlement releases it, and the orchard audit lists every transfer. A farm running 173 keys hence forfeits that exposure 173 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
